subject: FAD status: Beam Python 2 blocker + panel validation
body:
Hi Santiago,

Status on the FAD port. The embedding path is done: we mirror the vggish_model.ckpt checkpoint internally and extraction matches the reference implementation bit-for-bit on our smoke set.

The blocker is the Beam pipeline: apache-beam at our pinned version does not support Python 3, so the whole scoring job runs in a Python 2 virtualenv. That is an EOL runtime and security will flag it at launch review.

Validation is encouraging — on our enhancement distortion suite, FAD ranks systems in agreement with the listening panel on 9 of 10 pairs, versus 6 of 10 for the SDR baseline.

Proposal: budget two extra weeks to rewrite the pipeline against a Python 3 capable Beam release. Maren has a spike branch already.

Hyun
